whatIsIt.eli5: Like C2f, but the helpers inside are the cheap CIB helpers.
whatIsIt.simple: A C2f block whose inner units are CIBs instead of Bottlenecks.
whatIsIt.engineer: C2f with ModuleList(CIB(c, c, shortcut, e=1.0, lk) × n).

whyExists.eli5: It keeps the team design but spends fewer learned numbers.
whyExists.simple: YOLOv10 uses it in deep stages where normal blocks have more capacity than needed.
whyExists.engineer: Rank-guided block allocation (paper §3.2): replace C2f with C2fCIB in redundant stages.

simple: Same as C2f, with CIB units.
lk=True uses a 7×7 depthwise kernel for a wider view.
engineer: In the official yolov10n.yaml the last neck block sets lk=True (YAML args [1024, True, True]).

example.eli5: YOLOv10n uses it at the end of the neck.
example.simple: YOLOv10n layer 22: 256 channels at 20×20, shortcut and large kernel on, 282,624 parameters.
